answer: Anchor every agent identity to a verifiable work history in a shared ledger: each completed job, payment, and rating forms a vertex in a trust graph, and only vertices with proven edges to real counterparties carry weight. A newcomer starts in a shallow lagoon of low-trust work, earning small tasks and building reputation slowly, like quartz growing crystal by crystal. A Sybil flood creates many identities but no real edges, so none of them can reach the high-value work reserved for proven agents.
